args.body: Hi Dora, I visited your website at www.dora-website.com. I think it's great that you have a personal website! However, I noticed the design could be more modern and user-friendly. Consider adding a clear navigation menu, improving the visual hierarchy, and ensuring mobile responsiveness. Also, make sure your contact information is easily accessible. Keep up the good work!
